q: How long do we have to keep signed contracts?
answer:
Signed contracts are kept **10 years**, under the Commercial Act.

The clock starts at the end of the business (contract end), not the date the contract was signed. A three-year contract signed in 2024 and running to 2027 is kept until 2037. Anything under litigation or audit is not destroyed when its period runs out, even if the period has passed.

Source: RouteMind, Document retention (`/v1/nodes/retention-table/body` and `/v1/nodes/retention/body`). The approval area's line "how many years this is kept" pointed to the right place.
